summary: The prompt is strongly under-segmenting (only 35% of sentences split, avg 1.4 pieces), leaving latency gains on the table even on sentences with obvious safe clause boundaries. When splits are made, they sometimes land right before conditional/concessive clitics or right after quote marks, breaking tense agreement, numeral resolution, or proper-noun continuity. Several 'low similarity' cases are actually reference_suspect: the whole-sentence reference reorders quote/narration or adds paragraph breaks that a strictly sequential segment translator cannot and should not be expected to match.
